issues.quote: operating cash flow was $46.3 billion in fiscal 2022, close to the $46.3 billion recorded in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2022 operating cash flow was about $46.75 billion ($46.8B), not $46.3B. The $46.3B figure is fiscal 2021's (about $46.33B), so the 2021 value appears to have been reused for 2022.

data.summary: Revenue, net income, cash, total assets and total liabilities match Amazon's reported FY2021 and FY2022 figures. Fiscal 2022 operating cash flow is misstated as $46.3B; it was about $46.8B.
